text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein succeeds in crystallising Palestinian-Israeli agreement, saying: "We are on the verge of a new stage, a new peace, a new future."
- Islamist parliamentary deputies criticise Jordan Television's broadcast of New Year parties. Prime Minister Kabariti defends right of citizens to enjoy themselves.
- Kabariti to discuss economic relations with Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Aziz on Monday after delays in agreement on Iraqi oil supplies to Jordan.
- King Hussein saves peace process from falling apart.
- Three Jordanians imprisoned in Israel to return to Jordan on Monday.
- King Hussein saves Middle East from exploding.

- Israeli-Jordanian transport committee fails to reach agreement in meeting in Amman on Sunday over procedures for border crossings. Israelis fear "door-to-door" delivery of goods undermines security.
- King in intense effort to avert collapse of Israel-PLO accord.
- Aziz arrives en route to France to discuss oil, trade and sanctions.
